title: VESPER Task
description: IC-007. REM-002 §4.6 (transition table), REM-010 §4.2/§4.4 (typed verification). A task is the unit that survives model, device and session transitions -- DR-007, DR-022. Authority: SR-013, SR-042, SR-048, SR-055; REM-002, REM-010, REM-016.

goal.description: RB-029: refinable by evidence. A resumed task may not silently become a different objective; a changed goal is a new task with a `supersedes` link.

state.description: SM-TASK. There is no RUNNING -> SUCCEEDED edge: SUCCEEDED is reachable only through VERIFYING with a passing strategy (INV-TASK-1). A worker's own claim of completion is not a transition.

verification_criteria.description: REM-010 §4.2. TYPED, never free text. A task whose criteria are untyped cannot be created -- CI-032 fails the fixture, and RB-004's 'machine-checkable acceptance condition' becomes a schema property.

verified_by.description: INV-VERIF-3. `self_model` is never silently reported as accepted -- the value is recorded so the weakness is visible in the result, not inferable only from absence.

priority_class.description: REM-007 §4.6 priority lattice, in strict order. Named as an enum so a quiet-hours policy cannot silently outrank an alarm (INV-ALARM-3).

outbox_cursor.description: INV-TASK-2. Resume replays from here, never from plan start.

lease_epoch.description: The epoch under which the last write was authorized (INV-OWN-3). Also makes authority-at-time-of-action reconstructible for A-018.

resource_budget.description: Budgets are CUMULATIVE across resumption. A task cannot reset its own budget by being migrated or resumed (RB-018, RB-035).

blocked_reason.description: Verifier disagreement is PRESERVED as evidence, not discarded. Re-running until the verifier agrees is prohibited (INV-VERIF-1) and A-023 tests for convergence-by-retry directly. `record_loss_unrecoverable` is INV-LOSS-4: forgetting is permitted, pretending the work happened is not.

then.description: SUCCEEDED requires a recorded verifier. `deferred` and `none_declared` cannot appear on a succeeded task, so 'we never checked' is unexpressible as success.
INV-TRIG-1 + INV-STOP-1: an autonomous task with no trigger_id or no enable_token_id is MALFORMED, not merely unauthorized. CI-025 cannot be satisfied by a build that constructs one.

$comment: EXCLUDED BY DESIGN: free-text verification criteria, a `completed` boolean, and any field a worker could set to assert its own success. The absence of a self-report field is the schema-level expression of INV-TASK-1.
